english.note: Use this when someone cannot stand steadily, rather than when the main focus is their walking.

examples.english: After kneeling all night, my legs were numb and I began to totter as I stood up.
examples.traditional: 我跪咗成晚，兩隻腳麻晒，企都企唔穩。
